only_factor: training image sampling distribution; standard loss, same 25 classes and all images eligible

sampling.rule: r_c=min(3,max(1,sqrt(0.10/f_c))); w_image=max r_c of present weak classes, else 1

selection: fixed last epoch; no validation selection
normal_role: new candidate OOF calibration; same other-two-fold FDR15 selector
limitations: weighted replacement differs from natural shuffled sampling
all-class outputs are evaluated; no posthoc class routing to hide regressions
